name: neo-linoleum
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
description: An alternative tile engine: a much easier way to build your own tile set, plus tile tricks a fixed sheet cannot do. The game's own graphics do NOT come from here - the tile sets Angband ships (Original, Adam Bolt, David Gervais, Nomad) are core content and appear in the Graphics screen with no mod enabled, exactly as upstream. What this mod adds is the Linoleum loose-pack format: a directory of individual PNGs addressed by readable target maps (feat/trap/monster/object/flavour by name) instead of one tilesheet plus pixel coordinates, so a set can be edited one file at a time. The format also carries variant POOLS - one symbol, creature or item drawing from several tiles instead of always the same one, chosen by map position so it stays identical on every replay of a seed - and families for shared effect metadata. Build a pack from any legacy tileset with the `@neo-angband/linoleum` converter (docs/LINOLEUM.md); packs you build are yours and none are redistributed with the game, so enabling this on its own changes nothing yet. Status: the format, the converter and the pack seam are built; the shell's loose-pack renderer (individual assets, pools) is not wired up yet, so a pack declared in `tilePacks` today is loaded through the ordinary tilesheet path. Fully removable: disable it and the game's own tile sets are untouched.
